description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the MergeVideoFace operation for video face fusion
description_zh: 本文介绍视频人脸融合MergeVideoFace的语法及示例
name: MergeVideoFace

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入视频的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the reference face image for replacement. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:
Image formats: JPEG, JPG, and PNG.
Image resolution: at least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 4000 × 4000 pixels.
Image size: up to 20 MB.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
替换后的人脸参考图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：
图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG。
图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于4000×4000像素。
图像大小：不大于20 MB。
URL地址不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: reference_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:

True (default): Add a watermark.
False: Do not add a watermark
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加水印。取值范围如下：

True（默认）：添加水印。
False：不添加水印
parameters.name: add_watermark

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable face beautification enhancement. Valid values:

False (default): Disable face beautification enhancement.
True: Enable face beautification enhancement
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启人脸美颜增强。取值范围如下：

False（默认）：不开启人脸美颜增强。
True：开启人脸美颜增强
parameters.name: enhance

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:

EN (default): English watermark.
CN: Chinese watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值范围如下：

EN（默认）：英文水印。
CN：中文水印
parameters.name: watermark_type

Data.description_en:
The returned data.
After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoURL.description_en:
The URL of the processed video.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. To retain the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoURL.description_zh:
处理后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
